item.title: Postmortem: two-hour outage caused by an expired TLS certificate
item.description: An intermediate certificate expired on our edge fleet. Certificate rotation had been manual.

item.title: How a retry storm turned a small database blip into a cascading failure
item.description: Clients retried without backoff, overloading the primary database. The dependency became a single point of failure; failover did not complete.

item.title: Ransomware recovery: our backups were encrypted too
item.description: Backups shared credentials with production; the restore failed and we suffered data loss.
